message: `default_nodetype is not a Verilog-AMS 2.4 directive (an obsolete AMS-1.x spelling); write `default_discipline <discipline> instead
description: `` `default_nodetype `` was the name of this directive in early Verilog-AMS drafts. The current standard calls it `` `default_discipline ``.
actions: Replace `` `default_nodetype `` with `` `default_discipline `` and keep the same discipline name.
